title: When Models Outthink Their Safety: Unveiling and Mitigating Self-Jailbreak in Large Reasoning Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on general safety failures (harmful content generation, jailbreaking) and reasoning capabilities in non-religious domains like mathematics and coding.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
